name: Mio Naruse
source:
Mio is the daughter of the former Demon Lord Wilbert, inheriting his power. [url=/c152960]Jin[/url] adopted her, and now she is my sister. She might quarrel with [url=/c152920]Rias[/url] over the throne, but [url=/c144566]I[/url] believe I can resolve their problem. In the worst case, I will choose who will receive the throne myself.

[In game description]
